items.title: ASML Soars 10% in a Week as Chip Stocks Bounce and Musk’s Terafab Eyes a Million Wafers
items.summary: Key TakeawaysASML stock is up 10% in the past week as chip stocks rebounded and Musk’s Terafab reportedly set a target of 1 million wafers a month. Applied Materials and TSMC gained even more, so most of ASML’s jump came with the group.

items.title: Applied Materials (AMAT) Stock Slips After Record Q4 Earnings Results
items.summary: Applied Materials just reported record Q4 2026 numbers, yet the stock slipped 2.8% to US$370.25 by Friday’s close. That reflects investor emotion running ahead of the spreadsheet. Revenue for the quarter was US$10.4b, with basic EPS at US$3.43, capping a fiscal year that management described as record on both sales and earnings. Investors came into this report after a choppy stretch, with the share price down over 17% in the past month and almost 27% over three months. Today’s pullback...

items.title: Thierry Borgeat Says Chip Stocks Peak Every Two Years. His Chart Points to Another Top
items.summary: Nvidia just shed nearly 29% in a month, and one trader's circled chart says chip stocks have been here before. Four hard data points will show whether this selloff is a cycle top or just a pause.

items.title: Earnings week scorecard: beats rewarded selectively as AI-infrastructure names pull back
items.summary: Investing.com -- Beats were widespread this week, but the market rewarded only some of them. Cisco and Applied Materials both beat and both sold off. CoreWeave, Rocket Lab and Constellation Energy were rewarded. The week reads as a test of "beat versus priced-in" for the AI-infrastructure trade.

items.title: Applied Materials earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Applied Materials (AMAT) reported fiscal Q4 2026 on Nov 12, 2026 and beat on every headline line. The stock still fell. It trades at $367.76 (-3.46%) as of Nov 13, 2:53 PM EST, after the after-hours pop faded. The shares are down 20.8% over one month and 31.2% over three months. They sit far below the 52-week high of $739.67 and remain +64.7% over one year.

items.title: Applied Materials: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Margins have expanded for 14 straight quarters, so the profitability story is already building alongside the chip demand story.
